labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The discovery.k8s.io/v1beta1 EndpointSlice API is no longer served as of v1.25, breaking clients that still use it.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Users must migrate manifests and API clients to discovery.k8s.io/v1 to avoid failures from the removed v1beta1 version.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The v1 EndpointSlice replaces topology fields with nodeName and zone and makes deprecatedTopology non-writable, requiring manifest and client changes.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The events.k8s.io/v1beta1 Event API is no longer served as of v1.25, so clients using it will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Users must migrate manifests and API clients to events.k8s.io/v1 to avoid breakage from the removed v1beta1 version.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Event fields are renamed, type is restricted, and required fields are added for events.k8s.io/v1, so existing event producers must be updated.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The autoscaling/v2beta1 HorizontalPodAutoscaler API is no longer served as of v1.25, breaking manifests that use it.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Users must migrate HPA manifests and API clients to autoscaling/v2 to avoid breakage from the removed v2beta1 version.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: targetAverageUtilization is replaced by target.averageUtilization and target.type, requiring manifest changes for HPA definitions.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The policy/v1beta1 PodDisruptionBudget API is no longer served as of v1.25, breaking manifests that use it.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Users must migrate PodDisruptionBudget manifests and clients to policy/v1 to avoid breakage from the removed v1beta1 version.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: An empty spec.selector in policy/v1 selects all pods in the namespace instead of none, a behavior change that can alter eviction and disruption behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: PodSecurityPolicy is no longer served and its admission controller will be removed, requiring migration to Pod Security Admission or a webhook.
